subject.title: Runtime Self Context: give agents runtime, scale, offload, and cost awareness

question: Should OpenClaw accept a core runtimeContext config plus model-facing runtime tool as the v1 runtime self-awareness contract, narrow it before merge, or defer the design to plugin/provider API work?
rationale: The request changes core config, prompt exposure, model-visible tool policy, session/context state, and provider/plugin ownership, so source inspection cannot safely choose the permanent product/API boundary.

options.title: Approve V1 Core Contract
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90101 as the first non-mutating config-backed slice after its review blockers are repaired, and track dynamic provider refresh/action execution/cost estimation separately.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Limit the first slice to the smallest prompt/tool or environment-adapter contract maintainers are comfortable supporting and remove speculative fields until provider hooks are designed.

options.title: Defer To Plugin API Design
options.body: Keep this issue open as a design tracker and require a plugin/provider hook proposal before adding new core config or model-facing tool surface.

recommendation.title: Approve V1 Core Contract
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90101 as the first non-mutating config-backed slice after its review blockers are repaired, and track dynamic provider refresh/action execution/cost estimation separately.
